T5.title: Table 5. Gold-Standard-Free Estimates Versus Human Labels (191 Political Posts)
T5.note: Human values use the final human labels. Populations are four blocks of posts by time. The block-invariance test compares the primary model with one in which the LLM’s error rates vary by block (6 df); the dependence test allows a free joint distribution of the first and third classifiers given the latent class (2 df). The decision rule required the human-based sensitivity and specificity inside the latent-class intervals and a mean absolute prevalence error of at most 0.05.
